title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00087 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:

01:45 - 02:30: Waited on weather to pull production riser meanwhile skidded cantilever to f-15 d

05:30 - 06:00: Waited on weather to pull production riser significant wave height 5,1m meanwhile installed nt2 connector on multibowl

sections.text: Waited on weather to pull production riser meanwhile performed TBT for skidding
Waited on weather to pull production riser meanwhile skidded cantilever to f-15 d
Waited on weather to pull production riser meanwhile removed hatch and hole covers. Performed TBT with ongoing crew build scaffolding around hole openings
Waited on weather to pull production riser meanwhile installed scaffolding around hole openings in moonpool and WH performed TBT for installing nt2 connector and p/u cutter BHA cleaned shaker pits
Waited on weather to pull production riser significant wave height 5,1m meanwhile installed nt2 connector on multibowl
Waited on weather to pull production riser meanwhile p/u cutter BHA. Tested cutters on surface motor started at 100 LPM, knifes opened at 200 LPM.
Waited on weather to pull production riser meanwhile RIH with cutter assy, 2 STD 5 1/2" DP and multibowl RT engaged multibowl RT in multibowl.
Circulated out top layer of fluid column in riser to drain, 150 LPM 3 bar. Reduced rate due to overflow in drain system. Took fluid sample for analyzing.
Waited on weather to pull production riser removed riser tension system. Cleared rig floor for riser equipment from previous wells.
Waited on weather to pull production riser meanwhile performed TBT for displacing riser to clean SW
Waited on weather to pull production riser meanwhile r/u hoses from multibowl to kill manifold in order to take returns to pit.
Waited on weather to pull production riser meanwhile removed boat collision stool cleaned shakers and pits.
Waited on weather to pull production riser significant wave height reduced from 4,7m to 4m meanwhile continued removing boat collision stool
Attempted to displace riser to drain with 100 LPM 3 bar. Leakage through multibowl RT over the nt2 connector.
Increased flow rate to 1200 LPM 60 bar. Less leakage. Displaced riser to clean SW.
R/d hoses from kill manifold.
Increased flow rate in steps to 2300 LPM 80 bar. Cut production riser at 134,9 m. Significant wave height 3m
Performed TBT for removing hoses and valve outlets on multibowl.
R/d hoses and valve outlets from multibowl
Performed TBT for pulling inner string
Pulled multibowl to drill floor. Disengaged multibowl running tool and parked same in aft PRS.
R/u false rotary and pulled inner string. R/b cutter BHA.

R/d false rotary. Installed multibowl RT. Removed c-plate. Pulled multibowl and tensioner joint, cleaned riser on centralizer deck. Installed master bushing and elevator. Landed tensioner joint onto elevator.
